_meta.rule: confirmed = (1) PoB and RePoE agree on display name and support flag, RePoE release_state "released"; (2) RePoE quest_reward (QuestRewards.dat64) is null; (3) exile-leveling quests.json has no quest-offer and no vendor/Siosa/Lilly row under any of the gem ids (PoB table key, PoB gameId, RePoE base_item.id); (4) transfigured gems additionally require their base gem to have no RePoE quest_reward and no exile-leveling quest or vendor row (base and variant share a base item, so a base on offer leaves the variant unsettled). Ships with availability [] = no quest reward on record in two datamined sources, no vendor row in the poewiki-derived exile-leveling table; vendor absence itself is single-source.
